resource.name: Totonoe Skin Retouch for DaVinci Resolve
resource.creator: Totonoe
resource.description: Mac OFX skin smoothing with texture restoration. Color-based selection can affect similar tones together. Creator checked Free 20.3.2 on Apple Silicon only.
resource.access: Paid one-time license; watermarked free trial
resource.platformNotes: macOS 13+; Universal Binary for Apple Silicon and Intel, but creator testing covers Apple Silicon only. Windows is unsupported. Wide-gamut HDR can weaken skin detection; no viewer eyedropper.

requirements.dependencies: macOS 13+. Resolve version range is not established; the creator reports one tested setup, not a minimum or maximum version.
requirements.installation: Notarized macOS PKG installer; administrator permission and a Resolve restart are required.

evidence.note: Mac only, macOS 13+. Windows unsupported; Intel build supplied but not tested.
Universal Binary for Apple Silicon and Intel. Build availability is not independent installation testing.
Developer reports testing Resolve Free 20.3.2 on Apple Silicon. Studio is untested.
20.3.2 is a creator-reported test point, not a supported version range. Resolve 21 is untested.
Creator documents a notarized PKG, administrator permission and restarting Resolve.
Skin-color selection can affect multiple people and skin-like objects. Use a window or mask to isolate an area; wide-gamut HDR can weaken detection.
One-time Resolve license, separate from the Adobe versions; watermarked trial. The English checkout states that no Gumroad account is needed.

Smooths skin selected by color, with texture restoration and mask controls. Mac-only Resolve OFX; does not detect or isolate faces, so similar skin tones can be affected together. Paid separate Resolve license with a watermarked trial. The creator checked Resolve Free 20.3.2 on Apple Silicon; Studio, Resolve 21 and Intel Macs remain untested.
